name: clips/t6_harbour_oner
prompt: One continuous first-person POV shot, no cuts, no people anywhere, no hood, no hands. The camera walks slowly and steadily straight forward along the middle of the flooded modern concrete harbour promenade in heavy rain, always facing straight ahead toward the lit cable-stayed bridge, gentle natural walking bob. Glass apartment towers with hundreds of lit windows pass on the left, the black harbour and the modern skyline on the right. The floodwater on the promenade gets deeper with each step. At about four seconds a bright flash of lightning lights the whole city for a moment, then darkness returns. The camera stops walking and tilts slowly straight down to your own white sneakers standing ankle-deep, fully submerged in dark rippling floodwater on concrete, rain hitting the surface, and holds. Realistic, cinematic 35mm film look, no text.
